prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a hit while turning left in League City, Texas, and has whiplash. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1119; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the collision you were involved in while making a left turn in League City, Texas. Before we begin, do you consent to this statement being recorded?

A: Yes, I consent.

Q: Please state your full name and the address where you currently reside.

A: [Claimant name and address on file.]

Q: Can you walk me through what happened leading up to the collision?

A: I was driving south on a two-lane road and wanted to turn left into a shopping center parking lot. I stopped at the center line and waited for a gap in oncoming traffic. When I saw a gap, I started the turn, and then a vehicle coming from the other direction hit the front driver's side of my car.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before you began your turn?

A: I saw headlights in the distance, but I thought it was far enough away to make the turn safely. I should have been more careful.

Q: How fast do you estimate you were going when you started the turn?

A: I was going slowly, maybe ten or fifteen miles per hour.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt, and did your airbags deploy?

A: Yes, I was wearing my seatbelt. The airbags deployed.

Q: Can you describe your injuries?

A: My neck snapped back and forward really hard. I have stiffness and pain in my neck and upper back, and I get headaches. I started physical therapy a few days later.

Q: Have you seen a doctor for these symptoms?

A: Yes, I went to the emergency room that same day and I've been following up with my family doctor since then.

Q: Thank you. Is there anything you would like to add to your statement?

A: No, I think that covers it.

Q: Thank you for your time. This concludes the recorded statement.
